item.title: August 31, 2026 - Gratitude
item.description: Page 253. "Hopeless living problems have become joyously changed. Our disease has been arrested, and now anything is possible." Just for Today: Recovery has given me freedom. I will greet the day with hope, grateful that anything is possible today.
